tasks.label: Package source for AI review
args: from pathlib import Path; from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED; root=Path("."); out=root/"hirring-project-source.zip"; excluded={".git",".venv","__pycache__",".pytest_cache",".deepeval","node_modules"}; files=[p for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and not any(part in excluded for part in p.parts) and p.name!=out.name and (not p.name.startswith(".env") or p.name==".env.example")]; z=ZipFile(out,"w",ZIP_DEFLATED); [z.write(p,p.relative_to(root).as_posix()) for p in files]; z.close(); print(f"Created {out} with {len(files)} files ({out.stat().st_size} bytes)")
